quest.title: The Other Applications of Concresoil
quest.description: Akim seems to be troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I still need more materials...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your Concresoil coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Amazing, actually! As it turns out, this soil can be used for a wide variety of purposes.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: For example, it can be used to make pottery and fix cracks in houses.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: With a small adjustment of the mix ratio, I can even build houses with this soil.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: However... I'm running low on materials due to a surge in orders.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Critically, I've ran out of Slime Condensate. Traveler, could you please bring me three more portions of Slime Condensate?

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: So, Traveler, could you please fetch three more portions of Slime Condensate for me?

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I have made purchases from different channels or asked others for help.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I just didn't expect that Slime Condensate could run out so quickly...

talks.objective: Give three portions of Slime Condensate to Akim

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you obtained the Slime Condensate?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Thank you. Then I have all the materials I need for now.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Give me a second while I mix the Concresoil...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Akim starts to mix the soil...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Okay, it's done. Please take the soil to Nima.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: He has been waiting for it for ages.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: This child is... um... unusually imaginative.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Nima told me he wanted to make a group of talking "pot warriors" that can roll over enemies and have all sorts of magical powers.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: The power of these warriors will vary with the materials stuffed in their pot bodies.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: He even gave these pot warriors a name, called Ad... Well, forget it, I don't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I can't really make pot warriors with magical powers. But still, it's an interesting idea.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: So I thought, why not give him the soil as a toy gift?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: This way, he can make his own pot warriors and command them like a general!

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Ahem, anyway, please help me send this pot of soil to Nima.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Once his pot warriors are complete, maybe he will appoint us both "pot generals" as well!

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: #Hello, {F#Miss}{M#Mister}, what can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: Wow, this must be the soil that can make everything. Just like Akim told me!

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: #Yay! Thank you, {M#Mister}{F#Miss}!

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: Now I can make "Adri"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is Adri, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: #Didn't Akim tell you about it, {M#Mister}{F#Miss}?

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: I'm making some pot warriors. Adri is gonna be the first and the best of them!

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: He is a kind warrior with a good temper. When he awakens as a pot warrior, the first thing he will do is to apologize to the grass under him.

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: His power is... is...

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: I—I haven't decided on it yet... but you'll be the first to know once I have!

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: After Adri is done, I'll make Ivar, his adjutant, and Lasson, his disciple.

dialogues.speaker: Nima
dialogues.text: The three of them... no, the three pot warriors... They will embark on a long, long journey...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I still need more materials...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your Concresoil coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Amazing, actually! As it turns out, this soil can be used for a wide variety of purposes.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: For example, it can be used to make pottery and fix cracks in houses.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: By making small adjustment to the mix ratio, I can even build houses with this soil.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: However... I'm running low on materials due to a surge in orders.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Even the Whopperflower soil has run out... Traveler, could you please go and get me some more of that?

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Thank you. Don't forget, it's the soil where Whopperflowers grow that we're looking for!

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I've made purchases through various means and asked others for help.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: But I'm out of this particular type of soil. I really should have stored more of it...

talks.objective: Head to where the Whopperflower appeared
Bring the sample back to Akim

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Did you get the soil?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Thank you, these should last me for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I'm thinking that there might be other ways to improve the Concresoil...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: For example, perhaps the soil can also be highly water-retentive and nutrient-rich...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm just not smart enough. If it was those wise folks, they would have definitely come up with more good ideas...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Traveler! Thank goodness you're here. I was just in need of someone's help!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you've made progress in your soil research?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Well... I don't think I could call it "progress," but a customer of mine did give me some useful advice.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: He said that he enjoys growing flowers and the thing that troubles him most is finding the right soil.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: The soil needs to have good permeability and adequate nutrients. Plus, it should be water retentive but not soggy...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Knowing that I've made such improvements to the Concresoil, he asked me if I could devise a version of it for flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I found it worth researching, so I'm looking for other materials to further upgrade my Concresoil.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Could you please help me look for some fertile soil this time?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I'll mark the location of the soil on the map for you.

choices.text: Why is it so far away...

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I asked around, of course. It's a little out of the way, but they say the soil there is very fertile.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: But there seems to be a lot of monsters over there too, so I wouldn't dare to go myself...

choices.text: How did you find this place...?

talks.objective: Go to the place Akim recommended
Bring the sample back to Akim

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Did you get the soil?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: This is exactly what I'm looking for! Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Please take these as your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Well... as fertile as it is, this soil is pretty weighty, and it doesn't seem to have great permeability...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'd better mix it with some other soil types...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is awful. Where did I go wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Ah! It's... it's you, Traveler...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: *sigh* There's something wrong with my Concresoil...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Was it the mix ratio? Or the lack of experimental trials...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Many customers who have built their kitchens using Concresoil have reported cracking after only a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Perhaps the temperature grew so high that some parts of the soil just failed to work?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: *sigh* Anyway, I have to go fix those cracks for them.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: There were too many people needing repairs for me to take all the scraped Concresoil away, so I asked them to just keep it in some pots. And ah, there were very many pots indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you please help me collect the used Concresoil from this house, while I go to another one?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: *sigh* Where did it all go wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Did you get those pots of Concresoil back?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'll evaluate this batch of soil.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: How could this happen? Do I need to adjust the ratio again...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Ugh, why is making the ideal soil so hard?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Hurry and give the soil to Nima. He must be anxious from all the waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Did you get the soil?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Did you get the soil?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I'll go to the other places to retrieve the Concresoil. You should hurry too. I'm counting on you.
